Maria (Support): hey @Emily, FYI Harvest Health reports audit log exports for 2026-02-09 02:00-03:30 UTC are missing. Their sec team attempted an HSM-backed export and got repeated 403s from KMS. They opened a compliance ticket and want repro steps + attestation. Posting the customer error snippet below.

Oliver (SRE): can you drop the request_id and which key alias they used? also any recent key rotation events?

kms-bot: NOTE: key rotation event detected for alias redwood/harvest-prod at 2026-02-09T01:58:12Z (rotation-id: rot-xyz123).

Maria (Support): customer-provided curl (redacted token):
```\ncurl -i -X POST \\\"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/exports" \\\\ \\  -H \"Authorization: Bearer <redacted>\" \\  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\  -d '{\"dataset\":\"audit-logs\",\"start\":\"2026-02-09T02:00:00Z\",\"end\":\"2026-02-09T03:30:00Z\",\"kms_alias\":\"redwood/harvest-prod\",\"hsm\":true}'\n```
response: 
```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "error": "KMSAccessDenied",
  "code": "kms_403",
  "message": "key redwood/harvest-prod unavailable during rotation",
  "request_id": "req_3f9a7b"
}
```

Emily (Security): adding @Legal Ops and infra-sec. If the export failed during the HSM rotation window we need: exact rotation timeline, KMS audit entries (grant/revoke), ledger entries for audit exports 01:50-03:40 UTC, and any agent-side retry attempts. We must confirm PHI was not exposed to alternative keys. :warning:

Josh (Eng): I tried to repro in staging against a rotated key and see the same error: \"operation not permitted during rotation\" returned by HSM driver. Suggest a temporary fallback path: allow export with a non-HSM key under strict controls so we can produce the audit export for the customer while we complete attestation. Need ops/legal approval.

Legal Ops: do NOT move PHI to a non-HSM key without legal sign-off. We need to know what data fields are included in the export and whether the customer is requesting transfer to their environment. If they insist on immediacy, propose a controlled execution where Redwood performs the export into an encrypted S3 bucket under our custody and provides checksums + HSM proof once rotation completes.

Maria (Support): provided request details to customer (request_id=req_3f9a7b, alias=redwood/harvest-prod). Told them we're collecting artifacts and will provide ETA (approx 4 hours). Opened internal incident INC-20260209-17 and linked the compliance ticket.

Oliver (SRE): I'll pull KMS audit logs (rotation-id rot-xyz123) and ledger entries for 2026-02-09T01:45:00Z -> 2026-02-09T03:45:00Z. Also checking if we had an ingest spike at ~02:05 UTC that could have caused logging delays. If logs are missing from the pipeline, plan is to reconstruct from raw S3 writes + request_id mapping.

Emily (Security): thanks — once you have the artifacts please share GPG-signed hashes and timeline. Legal, please confirm if the proposed temporary export under Redwood custody is acceptable pending HSM attestation.

Legal Ops: acknowledged. We'll triage contract terms in the BAA and confirm permitted handling. If emergency remediation is approved, require documented approval chain + redacted PII minimization steps.

Maria (Support): Customer updated: they prefer Redwood do the export under custody. I told them we'll confirm legal path and get back.

Oliver (SRE): ETA for initial artifacts (logs + ledger) ~90m. Will update thread when pulled.

kms-bot: Alert: KMS rotation completed for redwood/harvest-prod at 2026-02-09T02:10:05Z (rotation-id rot-xyz123). Post-rotation operations may succeed; recommend retry only after ledger confirms rotation finalization.

Josh (Eng): noted. I'll prepare a fallback runbook and a minimal-scope export job that redacts sensitive fields unless Legal allows full PHI transfer.

Maria (Support): closing interim update to customer. will post final artifacts here.
